annotations.title: What agents did under Agent Passes

description: A report for a human on Agent Pass (Sui's on-chain agent authorization): for an owner, an agent or one pass, each pass's status, its rules in plain words (pools, caps, price floor, recipients), budgets left, today's usage and every transaction signed under it, including what Sui refused and why. Example: { owner: "0x1eb7...e0b1" } or { pass: "0x03c7...7bac" }.
